n1.TITLE: Advances in Neurosurgery
n1.SHORT: World-class neurosurgery is now available in Georgia!
n1.TEXT:
At Jo Ann University Hospital, neurosurgical procedures are performed using the Medtronic O-ARM 2 imaging system and the StealthStation S8 neuronavigation system!
Treatment uses some of the world's leading implants: the CD Horizon Solera Voyager, Artic-L and Clydesdale minimally invasive systems!

The technology enables the surgeon to work with high precision using a minimally invasive approach, significantly reducing operating time and blood loss, while postoperative pain and the risk of complications are virtually eliminated. Patients are discharged within 48–72 hours!

Head of department: neurosurgeon Giorgi Gegia.
📞 To book a consultation: 596 22 22 90
✉️ HEALTH@JOANN.GE
🌐 www.joann.ge

COMPANY_PAGE.TITLE: Company
COMPANY_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Modern Medical Solution — a trusted partner in modern medical products.
COMPANY_PAGE.INTRO_TEXT_1: Modern Medical Solution is an importer of medical instruments and materials, representing leading international manufacturers on the Georgian market.
COMPANY_PAGE.INTRO_TEXT_2: We work in three main areas — coronary, trauma & orthopedic, and aesthetic medicine. Our goal is to give Georgian doctors and clinics access to the same technologies used by the world's leading medical centers.
COMPANY_PAGE.VALUES_TEXT: The principles that guide our everyday work.
COMPANY_PAGE.VALUE_1_TEXT: We offer only certified products that meet international standards.
COMPANY_PAGE.VALUE_2_TEXT: Timely delivery and precise fulfilment of agreed terms are the foundation of our partnerships.
COMPANY_PAGE.VALUE_3_TEXT: We provide training, consultations and technical assistance to doctors and medical staff.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_1_TEXT: We source products directly from manufacturers, with no intermediaries.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_2_TEXT: Every product comes with technical documentation and instructions for use.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_3_TEXT: Products are stored and transported in line with manufacturer requirements.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_4_TEXT: Flexible logistics across Tbilisi and the regions of Georgia.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_5_TEXT: Our specialists support doctors when introducing new products.
COMPANY_PAGE.WHY_6_TEXT: We tailor cooperation terms to the needs of each clinic.
COMPANY_PAGE.CERTS_TEXT: Our operations and products comply with Georgian legislation and international standards.
